description: Explains what wallet(s) you have access to in your current environment, what chain(s) they work on, and what each one is capable of. Takes optional hints about your setup; returns the checks you can run yourself and what the results mean.

wallet_hint.description: Optional: name of wallet system you think you have (e.g. 'moltwallet', 'coinbase-agentic-wallet', 'metamask', 'raw-seed', 'unknown')

name: explain-my-wallet
